newsitem.title: UK: UK mother in teenage love tangle charged.
newsitem.headline: UK mother in teenage love tangle charged.

text.p: A British housewife who ran away to the United States with a 14-year-old schoolboy was charged on Thursday with abducting a child and indecently assaulting him.
Tracy Lee Whalin was released on bail after a brief hearing at a packed court in Nottingham, northern England.
The 33-year-old mother of three was escorted back to Britain by two police officers on Wednesday after being charged with "lewd and lascivious behaviour" in a Florida court.
British police who arrived in Florida earlier this week convinced the U.S. authorities to release her into British custody. Sex with children under 16 is illegal in Britain.
Whalin was found with her son's best friend, Sean Kinsella, in a condominium in the Florida Keys last week after an international search.
When Kinsella opened the condominium door for police, he said: "She's not decent right now."
The two disappeared from England two weeks ago after Whalin allegedly left her husband, took $5,000 out of the bank and drove off with Kinsella under the pretence of taking him to school.
